name: narrow_range_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when any 5-second bar has the narrowest high-low range of the preceding 7 bars (~35 seconds), institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms have reached momentary equilibrium — neither side is absorbing aggressively. This NR7 bar coils resting limit orders at its high and low. The first subsequent 5-second bar that closes above the NR7 high signals buy-side flow has overwhelmed the resting supply ceiling, triggering momentum algos and delta-hedging rebalances that extend the move 15-25 NIFTY spot points over the next 30-60 seconds. Trading only when the NR7 bar sits above/below EMA(60) filters against counter-trend fakeouts, which dominate when the 5-minute trend is directional and NR bars form against the grain.
core_signal_oneliner: NR7 bar (narrowest of prior 7 five-second bars, ~35 seconds) with subsequent close above/below NR7 bar high/low in direction of 5-minute EMA trend
